fields.name: MissingHealth
documentation: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of missing health with incoming heals subtracted.

fields.name: MissingHealthWithoutIncomingHeals
documentation: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of missing health. Incoming heals do not decrease missing health.

fields.name: MaximumHealth
documentation: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of maximum health.

fields.name: CurrentHealth
documentation: Clamp heal absorb values to the amount of current health.

fields.name: MaximumHealth
documentation: Clamp heal absorb values to the amount of maximum health.

fields.name: ReducedByIncomingHeals
documentation: Reduce heal absorb values by incoming heals, and vice versa, clamping to zero where necessary.

fields.name: Total
documentation: Use heal absorb and incoming heal values as-is without any reductions.

fields.name: MissingHealth
documentation: Clamp incoming heal values to the amount of missing health with overflow applied.

fields.name: MaximumHealth
documentation: Clamp incoming heal values to the amount of maximum health.

fields.name: Default
documentation: Use maximum unit health as-is without adjustments.

fields.name: WithAbsorbs
documentation: Use maximum unit health with total damage absorb shields added.

fields.name: amount
documentation: Amount of applied damage absorb affects with potential reductions from clamping included.

fields.name: clamped
documentation: If true, the value is in excess of the clamp boundary.

fields.name: amount
documentation: Amount of applied heal absorb affects with potential reductions from incoming heals and clamping included.

fields.name: clamped
documentation: If true, the value is in excess of the clamp boundary.

fields.name: amount
documentation: Amount of incoming heals across all units with potential reductions from heal absorb effects included.

fields.name: amountFromHealer
documentation: Amount of incoming heals from the healer unit. Will never exceed the all-units value.

fields.name: amountFromOthers
documentation: Amount of incoming heals from units other than theh healer. Calculated as the difference between amount and amount-from-healer.

fields.name: clamped
documentation: If true, the value is in excess of the clamp boundary.
